set -eu

install -d -m 0755 /usr/local/libexec
cat > /usr/local/libexec/certrotate-renew <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
umask 077
state=/var/lib/certrotate
live=$state/server.pem
renew_before=604800
mkdir -p "$state"
exec 9>"$state/renew.lock"
flock 9
if [ -s "$live" ] && openssl x509 -checkend "$renew_before" -noout -in "$live" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    exit 0
fi
node_name=$(hostname -s)
node_ip=$(ip -4 route get 1.1.1.1 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR==1 {for (i=1;i<=NF;i++) if ($i=="src") {print $(i+1); exit}}')
if [ -z "$node_ip" ]; then
    node_ip=$(hostname -I | awk '{print $1}')
fi
tmpdir=$(mktemp -d "$state/.renew.XXXXXX")
trap 'rm -rf "$tmpdir"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -sha256 -nodes -days 30 \
    -subj "/CN=$node_name" \
    -addext "subjectAltName=DNS:$node_name,IP:$node_ip" \
    -keyout "$tmpdir/key.pem" -out "$tmpdir/cert.pem" >/dev/null 2>&1
cat "$tmpdir/key.pem" "$tmpdir/cert.pem" > "$tmpdir/server.pem"
chmod 0600 "$tmpdir/server.pem"
openssl x509 -in "$tmpdir/server.pem" -noout >/dev/null
openssl pkey -in "$tmpdir/server.pem" -noout >/dev/null
mv -f "$tmpdir/server.pem" "$live"
restorecon -F "$live" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
ANTRIEB_EOF

command:
set -eu
cat > /usr/local/libexec/certrotate-https <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
#!/usr/bin/python3
import http.server
import json
import os
import ssl
import subprocess
import socketserver

PEM = "/var/lib/certrotate/server.pem"

class Handler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"
    def do_GET(self):
        serial = subprocess.check_output(
            ["/usr/bin/openssl", "x509", "-in", PEM, "-noout", "-serial"],
            text=True,
        ).strip().split("=", 1)[1]
        body = (json.dumps({"status": "ok", "node": os.uname().nodename,
                            "certificate_serial": serial}) + "\n").encode()
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)
    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        print("%s - %s" % (self.address_string(), fmt % args), flush=True)

class ReloadingTLSServer(socketserver.ThreadingMixIn, http.server.HTTPServer):
    daemon_threads = True
    allow_reuse_address = True
    def get_request(self):
        raw, address = self.socket.accept()
        context = ssl.SSLContext(ssl.PROTOCOL_TLS_SERVER)
        context.minimum_version = ssl.TLSVersion.TLSv1_2
        context.load_cert_chain(PEM)
        try:
            return context.wrap_socket(raw, server_side=True), address
        except Exception:
            raw.close()
            raise

ReloadingTLSServer(("0.0.0.0", 8443), Handler).serve_forever()
